run_simulation_setup: run the pybullet script to set up a VR KUKA robot simulation scene with gripper and objects
load_urdf_models: load URDF robot models like kuka_iiwa, pr2_gripper, and husky into the pybullet simulation
create_joint_constraints: create fixed and gear joint constraints between the KUKA arm and its gripper
reset_joint_states: reset joint states on loaded robots to specific position arrays using resetJointState
configure_motor_control: configure joint motor control with POSITION_CONTROL on KUKA and gripper joints
